name: storage-blob-s3
description: Files components keep by key, too large for a row (saved files, snapshots): storage.blob in an S3-compatible bucket (AWS S3, R2, MinIO, rustfs, a celld fleet's), signed with SigV4 over Web Crypto. Both targets.

environment.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environment.description: The access key id of the bucket's credentials (an R2 API token's, an IAM user's, MinIO's). Another name: the config's accessKeyIdSecret.

environment.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environment.description: The secret access key that goes with S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID; read through secrets at start, only signatures made with it are sent. Another name: the config's secretAccessKeySecret.

environment.name: S3_SESSION_TOKEN
environment.description: The session token of temporary credentials (STS); leave it unset for a long-lived key.
